steps.text: The Character Editor! Here you set the animations, offsets, position and colors of a character.
This is the character. Drag it with the right mouse button (or use the arrow keys) to move the offset of the animation being played.
The animations and their offsets. W/S go through them, SPACE plays it again and A/D go frame by frame.
Animations: add or change one with its name, its name in the .xml (or the symbol of the atlas), its framerate and if it loops.
Character: the image, the health icon, the scale, where it stands and where the camera looks, the color of the health bar and the postfix of its vocals.
Ghost shows another animation behind it, to line up the offsets. Settings: which character is open, and if it's a player.
The health bar and the icon, to check the colors.
The camera: E/Q or the wheel zoom, I/J/K/L or the middle button move it, R resets it. F1 shows every shortcut. Don't forget to save!
